skillPurpose: Teach a blank agent to locate an audit issue and write exactly one actionable audit opinion from the allowed materials.

fileResponsibilities.INDEX.md: Entry point. Tell the blank agent to read CORE first, use casebook only when scene features match, and write the final opinion to workspace/audit-point-output.md.
fileResponsibilities.CORE.md: Reusable audit material navigation, anomaly patterns, evidence localization workflow, opinion writing template, and failure lessons.
fileResponsibilities.casebook/: Scenario-specific audit issue patterns named by issue features rather than raw task ids.
fileResponsibilities.surface_contract.json: Strict JSON describing the entry files, casebook directory, patch files, and final output path.
fileResponsibilities.meta.json: Contributing instance ids, promoted rules with provenance, casebook map, and merge timestamp.
fileResponsibilities.open_observations.md: Short uncertain audit observations not stable enough for CORE.

finalProduct.description: One actionable audit opinion containing object, location, abnormal fact, risk, and correction suggestion.

casebookNamingPolicy: Use issue/scenario names, not raw task ids, unless a replay repair needs a temporary case-specific note.
